title: GET /api/v1/clusters/{cluster}/objects: result
description: Every row the Proxies page draws for one cluster, by name.

objects.description: The page of objects asked for, by name.

total.description: Value. How many objects the cluster has in all.

offset.description: Value. How many objects were skipped, as asked.

limit.description: Value. The most this answer lists, as asked or the default.

truncated.description: Value. True where more objects follow at offset plus limit.
